fichas.title: Water Sport, Marinas
fichas.summary: Marina design begins with a feasibility study and approvals for land and water. Location, water access, protection, boat capacity, area organization, berth layouts, breakwaters, and land storage all inform the design. Marina land-to-water area is approximately 1:1.5.
furniture_equipment: Electricity, water and waste-disposal supply columns

fichas.title: Land Storage of Boats
fichas.summary: Boats may be stored in sheds or outdoors over winter. Storage areas and access routes should accommodate boat transport, trailers, cranes, and turning movements. Boat stands require adequate safety spacing, and turning areas should be load-bearing and sufficiently large.
